title: MCP Server Approval
description: Vendor approval for an MCP server in the AI Registry

serverId.description: MCP server identifier (must exist in the Anthropic MCP registry)

version.description: Pinned server version (e.g., 1.0.1). Omit to use the latest version from the MCP registry.

config.description: Generic, tool-agnostic connection info for this server. Used to derive installConfigs entries (in this approval or another vendor's) that request derivation.

installConfigs.description: Tool-specific installation configurations. Omit if no tool-specific configuration is needed.

tool.description: Tool ID this config targets (must match a tool in the AI Registry)

installUrl.description: Deep-link URL for one-click install (tool-specific protocol)

openVsxUrl.description: Link to an VS Code extension on OpenVSX that installs the MCP server configuration

config.description: Tool-specific configuration object. Set to the literal string "derived" to request that this entry's config be automatically derived (from this approval's own root config, or another vendor's approval for the same server) using the tool's registered transform function.

metadata.description: Vendor-supplied fallback metadata, used only when the server is not found in the Anthropic MCP registry.

selfPublished.description: Attest that this organization publishes/maintains this MCP server. Renders a 'Verified by <org>' badge. Two organizations self-attesting for the same server fails consolidation.
